answer: Votes are weighted by trust-graph flow: weight spreads from a few audited seed accounts along vouches, and each voucher can pass on only a fixed share. A ring of fakes sits on a narrow ledge of edges, so adding heads adds almost no flow; every extra fake needs another real, spent-voucher edge, and each new edge costs more because honest vouchers' capped shares run out. Ember-like fresh accounts stay near zero; timber-thick history is needed.
